items.name: Nutanix VM without any VPC Attached
items.description: Nutanix VM that are not attached to a VPC. It is recommended to attach your VM with one of your VPCs
items.definition: From NX.VM WHERE NIC.Subnet.subnet_type not_in_all ('OVERLAY')

items.name: Nutanix VPC not connected to NAT External Subnet
items.description: Nutanix VPCs that do not have any NAT external subnet enabled. It is recommended to enable NAT external subnet for an authorize external connections.
items.definition: FROM NX.VPC where ExternalSubnet.Subnet.is_nat_enabled not_in_all (true)

items.name: Nutanix VPC with Only Default Routing Policy
items.description: Nutanix VPCs where only default routing policy is enabled. It is recommended to have custom routing policy created to have communications between resources in different VPCs, creates routes between multiple VPCs.
items.definition: From NX.Vpc where resourceCount(RoutingPolicy) = 0 OR (resourceCount(RoutingPolicy) = 1 AND RoutingPolicy.name = 'virtual-network-deny-all')

items.name: Nutanix VPC without Gateway
items.description: Nutanix VPCs that do not have a gateway attached to them. It is recommended to add a gateway for an authorized external connections
items.definition: From NX.Vpc WHERE resourceCount(NetworkGateway) = 0

items.name: Nutanix Clusters with Low NTP Host Count
items.description: Clusters that have too few NTP hosts
items.definition: From NX.Cluster where resourceCount(NTPServer) < 2

items.name: Nutanix Clusters with Remote Access By Password Enabled
items.description: Clusters that allow remote login using password
items.definition: From NX.Cluster where EnabledFeature.feature_name = 'PASSWORD_REMOTE_LOGIN_ENABLED'

items.name: Nutanix Clusters without DAR Encryption
items.description: Clusters that do not have Data-At-Rest encryption enabled
items.definition: FROM NX.Cluster where encryption_option = null and encryption_scope = null

items.name: Nutanix PC Access Control Policy with Excessive Admin Users
items.description: Admin access control policies that allow admin access to too many Users
items.definition: FROM NX.AuthorizationPolicy where resourceCount(User) > 2

items.name: Nutanix PC Authentication Configured with Insecure LDAP Connection
items.description: Active directories that have an insecure LDAP connection
items.definition: From NX.DirectoryService where url starts_with 'ldap' and url does_not_start_with 'ldaps'

items.name: Nutanix VMs potentially allow ICMP traffic from External IP/Subnets
items.description: VMs that potentially have ICMP open to traffic from External IP/Subnet
items.definition: From NX.VM WHERE (NetworkPolicyAppRule.direction = 'IN' AND (isOverlapIPv4(NetworkPolicyAppRule.src_subnet, Cluster.external_subnet) = true OR isOverlapIPv4(NetworkPolicyAppRule.AddressGroup.IPV4Address.ipv4, Cluster.external_subnet) = true) AND (resourceCount(NetworkPolicyAppRule.MicroSegICMPTypeCode) > 0 ))

items.name: Nutanix VMs potentially allow ICMP traffic from External IP/Subnets Internal to Cluster
items.description: VMs that potentially have ICMP open to traffic from External IP/Subnet Internal to Cluster
items.definition: From NX.VM WHERE (NetworkPolicyAppRule.direction = 'IN' AND isOverlapIPv4(NetworkPolicyAppRule.SrcCategoryReferences.VM.NIC.IPv4Endpoint.ipv4 , Cluster.external_subnet ) = true AND (resourceCount(NetworkPolicyAppRule.MicroSegICMPTypeCode) > 0 ))

items.name: Nutanix VMs potentially allow ICMP traffic from Public IP/Subnets
items.description: VMs that potentially have ICMP open to traffic from Public IP/Subnet
items.definition: From NX.VM WHERE ((NetworkPolicyAppRule.src_subnet_is_public = true OR NetworkPolicyAppRule.AddressGroup.address_group_is_public = true) AND resourceCount(NetworkPolicyAppRule.MicroSegICMPTypeCode) > 0 )

items.name: Nutanix VMs potentially allow ICMP traffic from Public IP/Subnets Internal to Cluster

items.definition: From NX.VM WHERE (NetworkPolicyAppRule.SrcCategoryReferences.VM.NIC.nic_is_public = true AND NetworkPolicyAppRule.direction = 'IN' AND(resourceCount(NetworkPolicyAppRule.MicroSegICMPTypeCode) > 0 ))
